activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, showering
Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
Getting dressed in work clothes and packing work bag and lunch
Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
Working as a health care professional: patient rounds, clinical assessments and medication administration
Taking a lunch break at the hospital

Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and eating dinner
Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen counters
Taking a shower and washing up after work
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and browsing on the computer
Winding down: turning off the TV, setting out clothes and phone alarm for tomorrow
